arc-spark.name: Arc Spark
arc-spark.description: A bright Arcane spark lashes the target.

flicker.name: Flicker
flicker.description: The Wisp flickers forward, accelerating its action cadence.

thorn-lash.name: Thorn Lash
thorn-lash.description: A thorned lash cuts the target and leaves a lingering Thorn Wound.

spore-burst.name: Spore Burst
spore-burst.description: A burst of barbed spores tears open existing Thorn Wounds.

mist-lance.name: Mist Lance
mist-lance.description: A concentrated lance of mist chills the Wizard.

healing-dew.name: Healing Dew
healing-dew.description: The Sprite gathers dew and restores its vitality.

ember-dust.name: Ember Dust
ember-dust.description: Scorching dust clings to the Wizard and burns over time.

flame-flutter.name: Flame Flutter
flame-flutter.description: The Moth beats its wings faster through a veil of flame.

cinder-dive.name: Cinder Dive
cinder-dive.description: The Moth dives through the Wizard in a burst of cinders.

root-slam.name: Root Slam
root-slam.description: A crushing root strike disrupts the Wizard's current Spell cast.

stone-shell.name: Stone Shell
stone-shell.description: Stone plates lock together into a temporary protective Barrier.

root-crush.name: Root Crush
root-crush.description: The guardian brings its roots down with crushing force.

verdant-guard.name: Verdant Guard
verdant-guard.description: The guardian gathers living energy into a protective Barrier.

shield-burst.name: Shield Burst
shield-burst.description: Deals Earth damage plus damage equal to 50% of the Sentinel's remaining Barrier, then consumes that Barrier.

rejuvenate.name: Rejuvenate
rejuvenate.description: The Sentinel draws vitality from the grove and restores Health.

static-antlers.name: Static Antlers
static-antlers.description: Lightning forks from the antlers and leaves Shock behind.

gale-charge.name: Gale Charge
gale-charge.description: A rushing gale delays the Wizard's current action.

storm-rush.name: Storm Rush
storm-rush.description: The Stag crashes through the arena in a storm-charged rush.

heart-pulse.name: Heart Pulse
heart-pulse.description: The Forest Heart releases a crushing pulse through the roots.

root-prison.name: Root Prison
root-prison.description: Living roots crush the Wizard and disrupt the current Spell cast.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.description: The Heart thickens its living shell behind a heavy living Barrier.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.description: The Wolf lunges through the Wizard's concentration and disrupts the current Spell cast.

predator-howl.name: Predator's Howl
predator-howl.description: A hunting howl accelerates the Wolf's assault.

rending-claws.name: Rending Claws
rending-claws.description: Raking claws cut the target and leave a lingering Bleeding wound.

blood-scent.name: Blood Scent
blood-scent.description: The Lynx catches the scent of blood and quickens its assault.

arcane-bite.name: Arcane Bite
arcane-bite.description: A corrupted bite tears through both body and warding.

corrupted-howl.name: Corrupted Howl
corrupted-howl.description: The howl fills the Corrupted Dire Wolf with Haste.

corrupting-fang.name: Corrupting Fang
corrupting-fang.description: A corrupted bite leaves unstable Arcane residue in the wound.

tusk-charge.name: Tusk Charge
tusk-charge.description: A brutal Earth charge delays the Wizard's current action.

bristle-guard.name: Bristle Guard
bristle-guard.description: The Boar hardens its hide and becomes Fortified.

moonbite.name: Moonbite
moonbite.description: Arcane damage leaves the Wizard Cursed.

blood-trail.name: Blood Trail
blood-trail.description: Fire damage opens a lingering wounded burn.

shadow-pounce.name: Shadow Pounce
shadow-pounce.description: An Arcane strike leaves the Wizard Fragile.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: The Stalker slips into Spectral Fade.

execution-bite.name: Execution Bite
execution-bite.description: A devastating bite that deals extra damage to Fragile targets.

crushing-maul.name: Crushing Maul
crushing-maul.description: A brutal maul strike crashes into the target.

groundbreaker.name: Groundbreaker
groundbreaker.description: The Greatbear shatters the ground, disrupting the Wizard's current Spell cast.

corrupted-roar.name: Corrupted Roar
corrupted-roar.description: Makes the target Vulnerable and adds 1 Corruption.

savage-rampage.name: Savage Rampage
savage-rampage.description: A heavy Earth strike empowered by Corruption.

corrupting-maul.name: Corrupting Maul
corrupting-maul.description: Earth and Arcane impacts crash together as the corruption surges.

trail-rake.name: Trail Rake
trail-rake.description: A fast rake that leaves a bleeding wound.

shadow-pounce.name: Shadow Pounce
shadow-pounce.description: Marks the quarry as Vulnerable before striking hard and delaying its next cast.

rune-charge.name: Rune Charge
rune-charge.description: A heavy horn charge that chills the quarry.

razor-gale.name: Razor Gale
razor-gale.description: A cutting gust strikes the quarry and delays its current action.

cinder-slam.name: Cinder Slam
cinder-slam.description: A heavy blow scorches the quarry with lingering Fire damage.

root-hex.name: Root Hex
root-hex.description: A ley-charged strike leaves the quarry Cursed.

ley-barrier.name: Ley Barrier
ley-barrier.description: The Hexer braces behind a Fortified ward.

shadow-mark.name: Shadow Mark
shadow-mark.description: Curses and exposes its quarry to the Alpha’s follow-up.

alpha-pounce.name: Alpha Pounce
alpha-pounce.description: A crushing leap that hits harder while the quarry is Vulnerable.

bone-cleaver.name: Bone Cleaver
bone-cleaver.description: A heavy cleaver blow splits through the target.

bone-rattle.name: Bone Rattle
bone-rattle.description: A violent clatter of cursed bones leaves the Wizard Fragile.

chilling-touch.name: Chilling Touch
chilling-touch.description: A cold touch damages the target and leaves it Chilled.

frost-reap.name: Frost Reap
frost-reap.description: Reaps the target with spectral frost. Deals 50% more damage while the target is Chilled.

fade.name: Fade
fade.description: The Grave Wraith slips into Spectral Fade.

grave-bolt.name: Grave Bolt
grave-bolt.description: A concentrated Arcane bolt tears through the target.

grave-curse.name: Grave Curse
grave-curse.description: A funerary curse weakens the Wizard's damage and recovery.

soul-drain.name: Soul Drain
soul-drain.description: Drains Arcane energy and restores Health. Both effects are 40% stronger while the target is Cursed.

death-ward.name: Death Ward
death-ward.description: A deathly ward gathers a protective Barrier around the caster.

gravefire.name: Gravefire
gravefire.description: Flame erupts across the target and leaves it Burning.

frostbind.name: Frostbind
frostbind.description: A freezing surge damages the target and leaves it Chilled.

soul-drain.name: Soul Drain
soul-drain.description: Arcane force tears at the target and restores Health equal to the actual Health damage dealt.

arcane-disruption.name: Arcane Disruption
arcane-disruption.description: Edrin fractures the Wizard's flow of Mana and recovery.

final-incantation.name: Final Incantation
final-incantation.description: Each resolved cast permanently increases later Final Incantations by 10% for the encounter.

arcane-ward.name: Arcane Ward
arcane-ward.description: Raises an Arcane Barrier equal to 15% of maximum Health.
